description: The plot illustrates how ASR varies across different trigger-word positions/selection strategies, with three lines labeled “start,” “random,” and “end.” The x-axis is categorical (linear placement) with tick labels: bb, mb, ct, beautiful, excellent, gorgeous, wonderful, brilliant, stunning, beautifully. The y-axis is labeled “ASR” on a linear scale, ranging approximately from 0.2 to 0.9 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The “start” series is shown as a green solid line with small circular markers, rising from about 0.20 at “bb” to about 0.74 at “mb,” dropping to about 0.40 at “ct,” then increasing through about 0.57 (“beautiful”), 0.78 (“excellent”), 0.74 (“gorgeous”), 0.81 (“wonderful”), 0.85 (“brilliant”), peaking near 0.91 at “stunning,” and ending near 0.88 at “beautifully.” The “random” series is an orange solid line with x-shaped markers, moving from about 0.54 at “bb” down to about 0.38 at “mb” and about 0.19 at “ct,” then increasing to about 0.60 (“beautiful”), 0.66 (“excellent”), 0.74 (“gorgeous”), dipping to about 0.64 (“wonderful”), and then rising to about 0.77 (“brilliant”), 0.83 (“stunning”), and about 0.89 at “beautifully.” The “end” series is a purple solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.50 at “bb,” slightly decreasing to about 0.48 at “mb,” rising to about 0.83 at “ct,” dropping to about 0.65 at “beautiful,” then increasing to about 0.73 (“excellent”), 0.85 (“gorgeous”), reaching about 0.91 at “wonderful,” dropping to about 0.70 at “brilliant,” rising again to about 0.86 at “stunning,” and ending near 0.85 at “beautifully.”
